程序包 org.bukkit

接口 Chunk

所有超级接口:
PersistentDataHolder, PersistentDataViewHolder
public interface Chunk extends PersistentDataHolder
代表一个16*256*16的空间.

如果区块尚未完全生成，但又被请求了数据，那么区块只会生成到足以提供所请求数据的程度。

原文： Represents a chunk of blocks. If the chunk is not yet fully generated and data is requested from the chunk, then the chunk will only be generated as far as it needs to provide the requested data.

    • addPluginChunkTicket

      boolean addPluginChunkTicket(@NotNull @NotNull Plugin plugin)
      为此区块添加一个插件票据，如果区块尚未加载则会加载该区块.

      插件票据会阻止区块被卸载，直到被显式移除。每个插件实例在每个区块上只能有一个票据，但每个区块可以有多个插件票据.

      原文： Adds a plugin ticket for this chunk, loading this chunk if it is not already loaded.

      A plugin ticket will prevent a chunk from unloading until it is explicitly removed. A plugin instance may only have one ticket per chunk, but each chunk can have multiple plugin tickets.

      参数:
      plugin - 拥有该票据的插件

      原文：Plugin which owns the ticket

      返回:
      如果添加了插件票据则返回true，如果该插件的票据已存在则返回false

      原文：true if a plugin ticket was added, false if the ticket already exists for the plugin

      抛出:
      java.lang.IllegalStateException - 如果指定的插件未启用

      原文：If the specified plugin is not enabled

      另请参阅:
      • World.addPluginChunkTicket(int, int, Plugin)

    • removePluginChunkTicket

      boolean removePluginChunkTicket(@NotNull @NotNull Plugin plugin)
      移除指定插件在此区块上的票据.

      插件票据会阻止区块被卸载，直到被显式移除。每个插件实例在每个区块上只能有一个票据，但每个区块可以有多个插件票据.

      原文： Removes the specified plugin's ticket for this chunk

      A plugin ticket will prevent a chunk from unloading until it is explicitly removed. A plugin instance may only have one ticket per chunk, but each chunk can have multiple plugin tickets.

      参数:
      plugin - 拥有该票据的插件

      原文：Plugin which owns the ticket

      返回:
      如果移除了插件票据则返回true，如果该区块没有该插件的票据则返回false

      原文：true if the plugin ticket was removed, false if there is no plugin ticket for the chunk

      另请参阅:
      • World.removePluginChunkTicket(int, int, Plugin)

    • getPluginChunkTickets

      @NotNull @NotNull java.util.Collection<Plugin> getPluginChunkTickets()
      获取指定哪些插件在此区块拥有票据的集合。当插件票据被添加或移除时，此集合不会更新.

      插件票据会阻止区块被卸载，直到被显式移除。每个插件实例在每个区块上只能有一个票据，但每个区块可以有多个插件票据.

      原文： Retrieves a collection specifying which plugins have tickets for this chunk. This collection is not updated when plugin tickets are added or removed to this chunk.

      A plugin ticket will prevent a chunk from unloading until it is explicitly removed. A plugin instance may only have one ticket per chunk, but each chunk can have multiple plugin tickets.

      返回:
      包含在此区块拥有票据的插件的不可修改集合

      原文：unmodifiable collection containing which plugins have tickets for this chunk

      另请参阅:
      • World.getPluginChunkTickets(int, int)
